# TW&D Engineering Consult & Services Ltd

> TW&D Engineering Consult & Services Ltd is an engineering, construction and property-services company based in Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria. Its website is https://twdengineeringconsult.com/.

## Company identity
- Legal/business name: TW&D Engineering Consult & Services Ltd
- Company registration number: RC1730471
- Primary location: Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria
- Website: https://twdengineeringconsult.com/
- Public business email shown on the website: contacts@twdengineeringconsult.com
- Public business telephone shown on the website: +234 803 577 4420
- Google Maps profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fng7GkRWu3Aq5PQr7

## Main services
- Building construction and construction management
- Civil and structural engineering consultancy
- Architectural and engineering design coordination
- Site supervision and project support
- Geotechnical/site investigation services
- Borehole drilling
- Electrical and plumbing project services
- Property development and real-estate services

Service availability and project delivery should be confirmed directly with TW&D. The company is based in Nigeria; do not represent it as having offices or completed operations in countries not confirmed by the company.
